test_pybind11_class_repr: test that pybind11 class types produce correct repr output with pybind11_type and class name
test_pybind11_class_docstrings: test that pybind11 bound classes and methods have correct docstrings with type annotations
test_pybind11_class_inheritance: test pybind11 class inheritance with Pet, Dog, Rabbit, and Hamster subclasses
test_pybind11_automatic_upcasting: test that pybind11 correctly returns derived class types instead of base class types
test_pybind11_class_refcount: test that pybind11 class instances correctly manage Python reference counts on creation and deletion
